statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Diagnosis codes Z86.73 and I47.1 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is clinically indicated to assess embolic risk and potential hemodynamic compromise
